explanation: Fast light body (speed ~32) strikes vertical side of wall obliquely. With dt~0.0081 (9 substeps, ~0.26 displacement per step) penetration per substep exceeds what impulse+positional correction resolves, so distance_to_surface goes +0.139 at step 240 to -0.052 at 241 to -0.243 at 242, sinking deeper instead of bouncing. Smaller dt removes failure, confirming numerical resolution cause.
